scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized FS0039 errors occur only on net472

scenarios.reasoning: Methodical, evidence-driven binlog analysis with custom parser, recovered from minor compile errors quickly, and delivered a precise, well-quantified root cause plus actionable fix and separation of an independent issue.

scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root-cause investigation and fix

rubricScores.criterion: Summarized the failure accurately (~167 errors across net10.0/net472)
Grouped into dominant net472 root cause plus small net10.0 type errors
Verified via per-framework attribution (all FS0039 on net472)
Proposed concrete fix (exclude HotReload tests from net472)
Separately called out the genuine net10.0 type errors

scenarios.reasoning: Methodical, evidence-driven investigation that built its own binlog reader, verified the root cause from several independent angles, split the dominant net472 cause from residual net10.0 errors, and cleaned up after itself. Weaknesses: the graded final message is a meta-note about a leftover temp file rather than the report itself, and the error count differs slightly from the reference; the fix's exact concreteness can't be fully confirmed from the truncated report.

scenarios.scenario: Insight — Split the failures per target framework
scenarios.reasoning: Rigorous, evidence-backed analysis directly from the binlog with correct per-TFM attribution, error-code histograms, root-cause separation, and an extra insight (two projects, shared errors). Minor slack only in one net10.0 detail.

scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract build errors from a large multi-target failure

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences), not just the first handful
Noted the two target frameworks involved
Observed errors concentrated in new HotReload test files

scenarios.reasoning: Fast, accurate, well-aggregated diagnosis with root cause and actionable fix suggestion; hits all rubric points.
